## Motivation

`--dataset-name random` replaces an invalid explicit `--dataset-path` with ShareGPT, so a benchmark can run against the wrong corpus.

## Modifications

Download the default only for an empty path and let explicit file/JSON errors propagate. Add regression coverage to the existing dataset tests.

## Accuracy Tests

```bash
HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 PYTHONPATH=python \
  python test/registered/bench_fn/test_benchmark_datasets_api.py -v
pre-commit run --all-files --show-diff-on-failure
```

47 tests and pre-commit pass on macOS arm64 with Python 3.12.7. The three invalid-path cases fail on the original code. Model evaluation is not applicable.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable; this changes dataset loading before benchmark requests are sent.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). Not needed for this fix.
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). Not applicable.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+    def test_random_dataset_rejects_invalid_explicit_path(self):
+        """Invalid explicit corpora must not silently benchmark downloaded data."""
+        fallback_path = self._write_sharegpt_json()
+        malformed_path = self.tmpdir_path / "malformed.json"
+        malformed_path.write_text("{", encoding="utf-8")
+        for dataset_path, error in (
+            (self.tmpdir_path / "missing.json", FileNotFoundError),
+            (malformed_path, json.JSONDecodeError),
+            (self.tmpdir_path, IsADirectoryError),
+        ):
+            with (
+                self.subTest(path=dataset_path),
+                patch(
+                    "sglang.benchmark.datasets.random.download_and_cache_hf_file",
+                    return_value=fallback_path,
+                ) as download,
+            ):
+                args = make_args(dataset_name="random", dataset_path=str(dataset_path))
+                with self.assertRaises(error):
+                    get_dataset(args, self.tokenizer)
+                download.assert_not_called()
+
+    def test_random_dataset_uses_default_or_explicit_corpus(self):
+        dataset_path = self._write_sharegpt_json()
+        self.tokenizer.add_tokens(["hello", "world", "how", "are", "third", "prompt"])
+        for path, download_count in (("", 1), (dataset_path, 0)):
+            with (
+                self.subTest(path=path),
+                patch(
+                    "sglang.benchmark.datasets.random.download_and_cache_hf_file",
+                    return_value=dataset_path,
+                ) as download,
+            ):
+                args = make_args(
+                    dataset_name="random",
+                    dataset_path=path,
+                    num_prompts=3,
+                    random_input_len=2,
+                    random_range_ratio=1.0,
+                )
+                rows = get_dataset(args, self.tokenizer)
+                self.assertCountEqual(
+                    [row.prompt for row in rows],
+                    ["hello world", "how are", "third prompt"],
+                )
+                self.assertEqual(download.call_count, download_count)
+
+    def test_random_ids_does_not_read_dataset_path(self):
+        args = make_args(
+            dataset_name="random-ids",
+            dataset_path=str(self.tmpdir_path / "missing.json"),
+            tokenize_prompt=True,
+            random_range_ratio=1.0,
+        )
+        with patch(
+            "sglang.benchmark.datasets.random.download_and_cache_hf_file"
+        ) as download:
+            rows = get_dataset(args, self.tokenizer)
+            self.assertEqual(len(rows), args.num_prompts)
+            self.assertTrue(
+                all(len(row.prompt) == args.random_input_len for row in rows)
+            )
+            self.assertTrue(
+                all(isinstance(token, int) for row in rows for token in row.prompt)
+            )
+            download.assert_not_called()
+
